title: Chúng tôi có thể ngồi cạnh quạt được không?
englishTitle: Can we sit by the fan?
pronunciation: Chung toi co the ngoi canh quat duoc khong
summary: For asking for a cooler table in a hot cafe, food hall, or open-front restaurant.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Ask before sitting down, while the fan, doorway, or open table is easy to point at.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Point to the fan or table. Keep the request light so it sounds like comfort, not a complaint.

phrases.vietnamese: Chúng tôi có thể ngồi cạnh quạt được không?
phrases.english: Can we sit by the fan?
phrases.pronunciation: Chung toi co the ngoi canh quat duoc khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Chúng tôi có thể asks can we; ngồi cạnh quạt means sit by the fan; được không softens the request.

breakdown.vietnamese: Chúng tôi có thể ngồi cạnh quạt được không?
breakdown.english: Can we sit by the fan?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at busy lunch counters, cafes, casual restaurants, night-market tables, and open-air rooms on hot days.

phrases.vietnamese: Vui lòng cho một bàn cho bốn người
phrases.pronunciation: Vui long cho mot ban cho bon nguoi

phrases.english: Is there a wait for a table?

phrases.vietnamese: Chúng tôi có thể ngồi bên trong được không?

phrases.vietnamese: Chúng tôi có thể ngồi bên ngoài được không?
phrases.pronunciation: Chung toi co the ngoi ben ngoai duoc khong

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: A gesture helps. Fan seating may mean one table over, closer to the doorway, or away from the cooking heat.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Move to clean-table, table-for-two, order-counter, long-wait, or recommendation cards if seating turns into service.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Table-for-one, table-for-four, wait, inside, and outside cards cover nearby seating questions.
